title: Easy Oven Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A savory and creamy Algerian dish featuring lamb, bay leaves, and salt-bake, perfect for a lazy Sunday, and Whole30-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb shoulder and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the bay leaves, salt, black pepper, and paprika, and stir to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Cover the Dutch oven and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the bay leaves and serve hot.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
